name: Fidenza
description: Particles follow Perlin noise flow field but draw thick curved rectangles instead of thin lines. Collision detection prevents overlap. 14 hand-crafted probabilistic color palettes. Variable turbulence (none/low/medium/high) and scale. Uses noLoop() — renders in ~1.2 seconds.
lessons: Flow fields + collision detection + shaped curves = organic layout. Weighted random for decisions. Palette probabilities. Single-pass rendering via noLoop(). Obfuscated/minified code for production.

name: Chromie Squiggle
description: Genesis Art Blocks project. Generates colorful squiggle paths from transaction hash. Hash pairs control: starting color, gradient rate, number of points, special traits (Super, Hyper, Full Spectrum). Simple algorithm, immense variety from seed.
lessons: Hash-driven parameters. Simplicity can produce iconic results. Rarity tiers from parameter ranges. Color gradient as primary visual feature.

name: Ringers
description: Wraps a virtual string around a set of pegs. Each output derived from unique transaction hash. Variations: peg count, sizing, layout, wrap orientation, color flourishes. Almost infinite wrapping possibilities from simple rules.
lessons: Constraint-based generative art. Physical metaphor (string + pegs). Emergent complexity from geometric constraint. Minimal palette, maximal structure.

name: Memories of Qilin
description: Generative textile art inspired by East Asian weaving traditions. Layers geometric patterns with fabric-like texture. Rich color palettes inspired by traditional dyeing techniques.
lessons: Cultural inspiration + algorithmic implementation. Layered pattern composition. Textile/fabric simulation through geometry. Cultural narrative in generative art.

name: Meridian
description: Generative landscapes using layered noise and procedural terrain. Creates atmospheric, painterly scenes. Combines 2D noise for terrain with atmospheric perspective.
lessons: Multi-layer noise composition. Atmospheric depth through color gradients. Painterly effect from noise-based rendering. Landscape as abstract composition.

name: Archetype
description: Recursively subdivides rectangles with weighted split decisions. Each region gets distinct pattern fill (lines, dots, crosshatch). Mondrian-like compositions with textural variety.
lessons: Recursive subdivision for composition. Pattern fills add texture to geometry. Weighted randomness for balanced compositions. Grid-based but organic feeling.

name: Gazers
description: Astronomical art tied to real moon phases. Generates stylized lunar imagery that changes with actual celestial events. Combines generative patterns with astronomical data.
lessons: Data-driven generative art. Real-world phenomena as input. Time-varying artwork. Astronomical precision meets artistic expression.

name: Subscapes
description: Abstract 3D landscapes rendered from procedural algorithms. Uses multi-octave noise for terrain, atmospheric scattering for sky. Creates vast imaginary worlds.
lessons: 3D perspective in 2D canvas. Atmospheric scattering simulation. Multi-octave noise for natural terrain. Abstract landscape composition.

name: The Eternal Pump
description: Animated mechanical systems — gears, pistons, pumps. Each edition is a unique perpetual motion machine. Simple geometric primitives create complex mechanical behavior.
lessons: Animation loops. Mechanical systems from simple geometry. Perpetual motion as generative concept. Geometric animation without physics engine.

name: 901 Generators
description: Layered abstract compositions from simple geometric rules. Pioneer of creative coding (co-created Processing). Minimal shapes, maximum impact through composition.
lessons: Minimalism in generative art. Composition over complexity. Layering simple elements. Historical significance of creative coding.

name: Autoglyphs
description: First on-chain generative art. 512 unique outputs generated entirely by smart contract. Uses modular arithmetic on token ID to produce ASCII patterns. Symbol sets: |/-\\ X/\\ +-|. Scheme types: nested squares, x-draw, perpendicular, etc.
lessons: On-chain computation constraints breed creativity. ASCII as art medium. Modular arithmetic for pattern generation. Extreme minimalism.

name: Terraforms
description: On-chain 3D terrain generation using heightmaps. Renders isometric landscapes entirely from smart contract output. Characters and colors represent elevation and biome.
lessons: Heightmap-based terrain. On-chain rendering constraints. ASCII/Unicode 3D illusion. Biome classification from noise.

name: Chaos & Order
description: Dynamic abstract compositions balancing chaotic fluid-like motion with geometric order. Vivid color explosions against structured backgrounds.
lessons: Tension between chaos and structure. Fluid simulation aesthetics. Color as energy/emotion. Dynamic balance in composition.

name: Light Years
description: Atmospheric light studies using layered transparency and bloom effects. Creates depth through luminous overlapping shapes and gradient blending.
lessons: Light as subject matter. Transparency layering for depth. Bloom/glow effects from overlapping low-opacity shapes. Atmospheric perspective.
